Commanders vs Cowboys Betting History

The Washington Commanders and Dallas Cowboys have met 121 times since the 1966 season. The Cowboys lead the series 78-43. Against the closing spread the Commanders are 53-64-3 (Cowboys 64-53-3), and the over is 47-45-1 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Sep 20, 2026, Cowboys 37-20.
